summary: @servicetitan/web-components preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: Version 38.1.2 of @servicetitan/web-components ships a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`, extracts and chmods the Bun binary, and then invokes it with `execFileSync` on the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) whose contents are heavily obfuscated (string-array shuffle plus a ~1000-entry numeric-constant charcode decoder) and are unrelated to the package's advertised purpose as a React microfrontend component library. The payload is not referenced by any code under `dist/` and is only reached via the alternate-runtime execution path, which evades Node-based scanners that trace `require()` graphs. Additionally, `package.json` declares `"files": ["dist", "src"]`, but the tarball ships `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` at the tarball root outside that allowlist — an inclusion gap consistent with the payload being introduced outside the maintainer's normal publish flow. This behavior fires automatically on `npm install`, executing opaque author-uncontrolled bytes under Bun on every installer machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
